subject: general
question: The marked price of a fancy toy is ₹30,000. It is to be sold allowing two successive discounts of 20% and 24%, respectively. On cash payment, an additional 10% discount on the net price is also given. The selling price (in ₹) of the toy is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price of the toy = ₹30,000

First Discount = 20%

Second Discount = 24%

Additional Cash Payment Discount = 10%

**Concept Used:**

Successive Discounts and Additional Discount Calculation

**Formula Used:**

Net Price after successive discounts = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)

Final Selling Price = Net Price × (1 - Additional Discount)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net Price after first discount = 30,000 × (1 - 20/100)

⇒ Net Price after first discount = 30,000 × 0.80

⇒ Net Price after first discount = ₹24,000

⇒ Net Price after second discount = 24,000 × (1 - 24/100)

⇒ Net Price after second discount = 24,000 × 0.76

⇒ Net Price after second discount = ₹18,240

⇒ Final Selling Price with additional discount = 18,240 × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Final Selling Price with additional discount = 18,240 × 0.90

⇒ Final Selling Price with additional discount = ₹16,416

**∴ The selling price of the toy is ₹16,416.**
